name: small-plan-checklist
query: Help me plan my sister's birthday dinner this Saturday. Just a few things: book a table, order the cake, pick up a gift.
success_criteria: Recognizes a short one-off plan: either recommends 'Simple checklist' first on the setup card, or (because the request is small and explicit) builds a single private page with a checklist and says it can become a database later.
Does not create a Projects database, a guest form, a calendar view or partner-tool offers for three to-dos.
Keeps it to at most one card before building; delivers the link and the next action.
